method: Fig. 3 is vector graphics. Marker centres and the ends of the lines through them were read from the PDF drawing commands and converted using the labelled ticks at 10^-5 Hz, 0.01 Hz, -50 s and 200 s.
other_marks_in_figure: One rectangular axis box with major and minor ticks on all four sides. A horizontal line at 0 s crosses the plot in the same stroke as the axes. The horizontal axis is labelled Temporal Frequency (Hz). No second series, curve, arrow, open symbol, or inset.
